segments.name: Single operating segment
segments.description: The company runs its business as one segment, reviewed on a consolidated basis by its CEO, with revenue from Australia.
segments.evidence: The Group manages its operations and allocates resources as a single operating segment.

changes.text: In November 2025 the company disposed of its interests in the WFOEs and the VIE structures in mainland China.
changes.evidence: In November 2025, the Parent entered into a Share Transfer Agreement to dispose of its equity interests in Romantic Park, a Cayman Islands entity indirectly holding the entire equity interest in the WFOEs.
